title: Air through a shell
hook: A shell protects an embryo without sealing it off.

knows: Animals have structures and activities that can be studied.
doesNotKnow: The arrows show oxygen moving inward through pores and carbon dioxide moving outward. The shell protects the developing embryo but allows gas exchange; the diagram exaggerates pore sizes and simplifies the membranes inside.

misconception: The features shown in this question have only one possible interpretation.
objective: A developing bird embryo is enclosed by an intact eggshell. How can oxygen reach it?
